title: Custody class: UNTRACKED cited receipts vanished from receipts/ twice (v0-live, c9-cadence) — cited receipts must be tracked + probed
body:
Two independent discoveries today (2026-07-07):
1. receipts/v0-live-20260623T105829Z.json — the seed segment's only run receipt, cited by every W1/W1b bill row — missing from canonical receipts/; survived ONLY in a seed-export staging copy; restored via PR #373.
2. receipts/c9-cadence/ — the ENTIRE directory, including code-vs-docs-20260702T180521Z.json (the C9 witness that July 4-5 boards cite verbatim as AUDIT-OK) — gone; the fresh board (152259Z) honestly reports the class empty and C9 lost its witness. Three byte-identical copies survived in an older session's sandbox fixture trees; content verified against the board's own quoted values (code_fraction 0.3113 exact match); restoration queued (annexcure lane, one PR, WITH spend-annex sidecars for both since both predate the annex convention — the v0-live restoration without a sidecar is exactly what flipped C(-1) RED today).

Neither file was ever git-tracked (no git history exists) — they vanished via filesystem operations invisible to git; the deleting op is unidentified and likely unidentifiable. The CLASS FIX, not the whodunit:
- **Rule: any receipt CITED by a board receipt, bill row, or other receipt MUST be git-tracked.** Untracked = one filesystem op from silent loss, and it has now happened twice.
- **Probe: cited-path custody check** — walk the newest board receipt + every verdict-bearing receipt's internal citations; every cited receipts/ path must (a) exist and (b) be tracked. Missing/untracked = RED row (or a C(-1)-style disclosed exclusion), because a claim whose witness can silently vanish is a claim without a witness.
- Backstop: sandbox/fixture seeding (which is what accidentally saved c9-cadence) is luck, not custody.

title: W1c prereg (FROZEN): K>=10 fresh-batch paired fp32 CI — the #339 §4.1 mandatory gate
body:
Pre-registration, frozen BEFORE any batch is built or eval run. This is #339 §3 row 1 — the mandatory park gate (#339 §4.1: 'a bare token-match without the statistical confirmation licenses NO park') — extended to also generalize W1b's finding (#355 result + fp32 addendum).

## Design
1. **Batches:** K=10 fresh certified 16-window batches from the clean held-out stratum. Each batch: disjoint from the training front (window index > max training index at ceiling, re-derived per batch), disjoint from every other batch in the set, disjoint from the original certified batch (sha 91069e33…8929). Each passes the SAME certification as w2-heldout-decontam-20260707T055843Z: full-corpus contamination recheck with self-location exclusion, 16/16 clean windows, deterministic re-derivation inside the receipt.
2. **Evals:** paired fp32 (and bf16, disclosed) eval of THREE checkpoints on every batch: seed step-610 (cbase-v0, model.pt sha 1ec99451…), grown terminal step-766 (model.pt sha 58e8e989…), from-scratch control step-50 (reconstructed per the bit-exact replay protocol of w1-fp32-check). Forward-only; minutes of GPU total.
3. **Statistics:** per-batch margins M1 = grown − control, M2 = seed − grown. Bootstrap 95% CI (10k resamples) on each margin's mean across the K batches.

## Frozen outcome semantics
- **Q1 (the park gate):** M1 CI entirely > 0 (control strictly below grown across batches) → W1's collapse measurement is CONFIRMED multi-batch; the §4.1 gate is SATISFIED (park becomes operator-available, never automatic — L7). M1 CI containing 0 → W1's margin is single-batch-unconfirmed; no park; the W1 claim drops to 'single-batch measurement' wherever it appears.
- **Q2 (W1b generalization):** M2 CI entirely > 0 → the grow segment's small fp32 gain generalizes. M2 CI containing 0 or < 0 → the 0.036 single-batch gain is noise-level; the bf16-bounded 'zero grid points' reading gains multi-batch support.
- No other claims move on this receipt. Single-seed caveat remains regardless (seeds=1 everywhere).

## Kill criteria (stated now)
- Certification cannot produce K=10 clean batches → report achieved K with per-batch receipts; K in [5,9] = run with disclosed reduced power; K < 5 = the gate CANNOT run as registered — stop, receipt, operator decides (no silent redesign).
- Any batch failing sha-pinned re-derivation at eval time voids that batch only, disclosed.

## Price (disclosed)
- Certification: the recheck cache (#359) keys on batch sha, so each NEW batch pays a full ~25-min CPU scan → ~4h CPU for K=10 UNLESS the builder amortizes one persistent corpus window-hash index across all K (exactly #370 cure 1 — this prereg is its first paying customer). Either path is receipted; the index, if built, is sha-pinned to the corpus manifest.
- Eval: 3 checkpoints × 10 batches, forward-only fp32 — minutes of GPU inside one lease window.

## Provenance interlocks
Every receipt carries: corpus combined_sha256 (aa48f6ee…), per-batch sha + decontam receipt path, checkpoint model.pt shas as above, candidate-window derivation MODE (per #371's disclosure floor), and the classifier code sha.

title: Contamination recheck must not cost 25 CPU-minutes per launch: persistent corpus n-gram index + GPU overlap
body:
Operator probe 2026-07-07: the GPU sits near-idle (~2%) for ~25 minutes of CPU recheck to gate a ~7-minute training leg — a 3.5:1 gate-to-work inversion. The #359 cache only kills REPEAT rechecks (same batch+receipt+code triple); every new triple pays the full scan again. The corpus itself changes ~never.

Cures, in preference order (receipts to decide):
1. **Persistent corpus window-hash index**: build the n-gram/window hash structure over shards-v0 ONCE, sha-pin it to the corpus manifest (combined_sha256), store beside the shards; every recheck loads the index (seconds) instead of rescanning 6.98B windows. Invalidate on corpus sha change. This converts EVERY future recheck — any batch, any code version — to seconds. Est. index size and build cost to be measured first (one lane, one receipt).
2. **Overlap, not just speed**: recheck runs on CPU while the GPU leg's model load + optimizer init + checkpoint load proceed concurrently, with the train loop blocked on the recheck verdict (fail-closed: refusal tears down before the first step). Cheap to implement, saves minutes even with cure 1.
3. (Rejected unless 1 fails) GPU-accelerating the scan itself — more code for less win than a persistent index.

Constraints: fail-closed semantics unchanged (index-missing or sha-mismatch → full scan, disclosed in receipt); the receipt must state which path ran (index-hit / full-scan / cache-hit) — a silent fast path is indistinguishable from a skipped check; L2 receipts-only.

Origin: tonight's W1b window — two launch attempts, both spending their wall-clock in CPU recheck while the GPU idled; the operator caught the shape from the chair.

title: Lease-window placeholder: the cockpit's screen slot must say WHY it is empty
body:
jun-sim tick 21 (2026-07-07). During a GPU-lease training leg the cockpit is deliberately down — and the operator's left half is simply EMPTY. Broken and working look identical from the chair; the explanation lives in a briefing file he would have to open. The visible-living-system bar (P-C) fails exactly here.

Spec sketch: when a lease teardown begins, paint a minimal placeholder in the cockpit's slot — a tiny always-on-top text pane or console banner: 'EMBER — GPU leased to <purpose> since <t>, cockpit returns ~<expected_end> (receipts: <path>)'. It reads state/gpu-lease.json (the #362 convention) and closes itself on cockpit relaunch. Constraints: ledgered like any visible window (window-ledger row), single-token wt title if wt-hosted, zero GPU/VRAM use, never a live terminal that only exists to be screenshotted — a static banner is the point, its PURPOSE is to be looked at. The teardown/relaunch choreography (tonight's W1b window is the template) gains one paint + one close step.

title: Cockpit liveness watchdog: standing loop for the body's up/corpse/wrong-state detection
body:
## Problem (jun-sim tick 20, 2026-07-07)

Tonight's cockpit chain — deliberate teardown, relaunch contract, CreateProcess corpse visible on the operator's screen for ~27 minutes, cured relaunch — was entirely hand-coordinated lane work. There is NO standing mechanism that keeps the body's liveness true. P-C says the body 'never lags the organism' and is 'the operator's audit channel on every other claim'; a corpse error pane occupying the cockpit's screen slot for half an hour is the named failure state, and it was caught by a coordinator poke, not by a loop.

## Spec floor
A watchdog probe, cadence ~2-5 min, that asserts the COMPOSED liveness predicate:
1. window exists with the ledgered title/HWND (UIA/enumeration tier, not process listing — wt is single-process-multi-window),
2. backing ember.exe process alive and parented to that window,
3. renderer heartbeat (the activity-event transport from #309 gives a cheap pulse; a frame counter or event timestamp newer than N s),
4. model residency consistent with declared mode (VRAM tenant present in inference mode, ABSENT during a GPU-lease training leg — the watchdog must be lease-aware and treat 'cockpit deliberately down' as a healthy state when the lease ledger says so).

## Policy on failure
- corpse/wrong-state detected -> capture (PrintWindow) + classify (error pane vs hung vs missing) -> receipt row.
- Restore policy is CONFIGURABLE and defaults to REPORT-ONLY escalating to auto-restore only for the unambiguous cases (no window + no process + no lease = relaunch with the known-good command shape). NEVER auto-relaunch during a training lease; never kill anything (clean-exit only, receipts-first).
- Every detection and action is a receipt (JSONL), and the board's body-pillar conditions may consume them.

## Constraints
- Launch command shape is receipted: single-token --title, direct wt invocation (PS5.1 Start-Process array marshaling mangles multi-word titles - 2026-07-07 corpse receipt).
- Kill-discipline and window-hygiene rules bind: PID-cohort verified, ledger rows updated in place, WM-close-class primitives only from an agent context.
- The watchdog itself must be visible in the ledger (a headless loop that dies silently recreates the problem one level up).

title: ConPTY injects NUL bytes into styled non-ASCII glyph runs (Windows console-host layer)
body:
## Summary

Related to #343 (PR #352 fixes the styled-bar half of that defect at the render-pipeline
level). This ticket is the remaining, separate half: raw NUL (0x00) bytes are injected into
the terminal stream by the Windows ConPTY/conhost layer itself, for specific styled-glyph
content, on a real pty — outside this codebase's write path entirely.

## Evidence (three independent, receipted experiments)

All against the same real-pty repro (node-pty on Windows, 190x85, a Homescreen border/rule
composition plus a bottom status-adjacent element — reliably reproduces 408 NUL bytes across
runs) and the issue's own capture rig (`scratch/clirebuild/capture-190x85.mjs`, 976 NUL bytes
across 8 runs at a slightly larger, more complex composition):

1. **Pre-write instrumentation (decisive).** `process.stdout.write` was wrapped inside the
   real pty-hosted child process to check every string passed to it for a literal NUL
   character before it goes anywhere near the pty. Result: 0 NUL bytes seen pre-write across
   repeated runs, while the SAME run's pty-side capture (`p.onData`) showed ~400+ NUL bytes.
   The corruption is added strictly between our `write()` call and the pty's read side.

2. **Chunk-size invariance.** Forcing all writes through small (64-byte) chunks vs. one
   large single write produced an identical NUL count. Rules out "a chunk boundary splits a
   multi-byte UTF-8 sequence" as the mechanism — if that were it, changing where chunk
   boundaries fall should have changed the outcome.

3. **Boot-defer invariance.** Deferring the first paint by 0ms / 500ms / 1500ms after process
   start (letting process startup and stdin raw-mode negotiation fully settle before anything
   is painted) produced an identical NUL count in all three cases (408/408/408). Rules out
   "boot-time write contention/interleaving" as the mechanism.

## Deterministic, content-dependent pattern

The NUL run-length pattern is identical across separate process launches and closely tracks
the border panel's own `rightFill` math (the horizontal-rule fill computed in
`logo-homescreen.ts`'s `paintBorder` title-centering logic) — e.g. one run is exactly 180
NUL bytes, matching a `rightFill=180` computed for a 190-wide border title at that viewport.
This points at long, identically-styled runs of a non-ASCII glyph (the box-drawing `─`,
U+2500, under a truecolor style) as the specific trigger, not a general/random corruption.

## What #352 already fixes (do not re-litigate)

#352 fixed a real, separate, in-code bug: a style-tracking defect that let a prior write's
style (e.g. the prompt cursor's inverse) leak forward onto unrelated content, producing the
`\x1b[1m\x1b[2m\x1b[7m` (bold+dim+inverse) stack the operator originally saw as a solid
grey/inverted bar. After that fix, the NUL bytes described here still occur (unchanged byte
count and run-length pattern), but are now preceded by nothing worse than plain dim — with
no inverse/bold, ConPTY-injected NULs render as unstyled blanks, which is invisible/benign at
the operator's viewport. This ticket is only about the underlying byte-level corruption
itself, which is now believed cosmetically inert but not eliminated.

## Candidate directions (none committed — needs its own investigation)

- Try a different pty backend / library (alternatives to node-pty's ConPTY wrapping on
  Windows) to see if the same content reproduces the same corruption.
- File an upstream report against Microsoft's conhost/ConPTY (or node-pty, if the wrapping
  layer itself is implicated) with the reproduction steps and byte-level evidence above.
- Identify and document an "avoid conditions" workaround (e.g. does breaking up a long
  identically-styled non-ASCII run into shorter styled segments change the outcome? untested
  so far) as a cheaper mitigation if upstream fixes are slow.

## Repro

`scratch/clirebuild/capture-190x85.mjs` (spawns a compiled `ember.exe`, cols=190 rows=85,
captures via `p.onData`, settles 10s) reliably reproduces this against any build, including
one with #352's fix applied.

title: W1 post-receipt check battery: target re-eval + eval-noise + grow-step marginal control (builder-dispatchable, gated on the clean W1 receipt)
body:
Executes the discriminating checks pre-registered in #339 §3, in cost order, the moment the W1 clean terminal receipt lands. Reading rules are #339's; this issue is the frozen builder spec. All runs governed (VRAM fraction cap + headroom assert + no-inference-holder assertion in every launch receipt, per the GPU-lease rule).

## Check 1 — target self-comparison bias (#339 §3 row 2; cheapest, first)
Re-evaluate the rung-1 grown checkpoint (models/cbase-grow-rung/rung1-20260703T155447Z/stabilize/checkpoints/step-00000766) on the certified 16-window held-out batch 10×, fp32 loss accumulation (model may stay bf16; accumulate/reduce in fp32), fixed seeds enumerated in the receipt. Also diff the launch-time vs in-loop eval code paths in scripts/w1_collapse_control_run.py for mode/dtype asymmetry (lines ~546-667 vs ~1524-1542). Output: receipt with the 10 values + mean/std + the code-path diff finding. Kills the collapse reading if fp32 re-eval lands materially below 9.375 (early-stop fired on a quantization-inflated target).

## Check 2 — paired fresh-batch eval feasibility prerequisite (#339 §3 row 1 amendment)
The certified stratum spans ~47 windows ≈ 2-3 non-overlapping 16-window batches; K≥10 needs a new decontam-certification pass over additional clean windows (tooling: the 055843Z certifier). Deliverable: the certification receipt for ≥160 fresh clean windows (10 batches), then the paired eval (step-50 control ckpt vs grown ckpt, per-batch paired diffs, bootstrap 95% CI). Decision rule per #339 §4.1: a bare token-match licenses NO park without this CI.

## Check 3 — grow-step marginal value control (#339 §3 row 4; the sharpest)
(a) Eval the PRE-grow checkpoint on the certified batch (one forward pass, receipt). (b) Continue-train the pre-grow checkpoint UNWIDENED for exactly 1,572,864 tokens (the stabilize segment's bill: 96 steps × batch16 × seq1024), same stream discipline as W1's control, then eval. Marginal grow value = (b) vs the post-grow target on paired batches. Kills the 'grow event worthless' reading if post-grow beats the unwidened continuation at matched marginal tokens — the match would then indict the seed-dominated lineage bill (9,994,240 of 12,550,144 tokens), not the growth mechanism.

## Eval-noise context (recorded, not assumed)
Per-batch eval std 0.7059 exists receipted for a DIFFERENT checkpoint (receipts/cbase-verify-attempt3-20260707T073843.json, 10 batches, seq512) — cross-checkpoint transferability is a named caveat (#339 addendum); check 2's paired design is chosen so no reading depends on it.

## Ordering + gates
Check 1 runs first (seconds of GPU); its receipt is required context for reading the W1 number at all. Check 2's certification pass is CPU-side and can start immediately. Check 3 is a rung-0-width training run (~minutes) and fires only after checks 1-2 are receipted. Every receipt cites #339. No check runs while the W1 leg itself is on the GPU.

title: Cockpit boot loads the resident inference model unconditionally — needs GPU-lease awareness (OOM-killed a live training leg)
body:
## Incident (2026-07-07, receipts in scratch/w1-control/live/w1-live-20260707T101234Z + scratch/renderfix context)

W1 collapse-control attempt 3 (1.22B bf16 training leg) launched 10:12:34Z with a passing VRAM preflight (93.7% free). At 10:13:46Z the ember-cli cockpit was launched visibly with cwd=B:/M/ember; its boot path unconditionally spawned llama-server (Qwen3.6-27B-Q4_K_M, port 8082), loading ~10.5GB into VRAM. At 10:39Z the training leg's first backward pass failed: torch.OutOfMemoryError (tried 512MiB; 13.42GiB physically free but pool contested/fragmented under the process's 19.19GiB governor cap). The training leg died after a step-0 eval that exactly reproduced the prior attempt (10.5625).

## Defect
The cockpit's boot loads the resident model unconditionally. The body ate the organism's compute: L6 (earned compute) and the standing 1-model-at-a-time serialization both imply a training leg owns the GPU while alive.

## Proposed cure (product side)
- Model lazy-load: boot the TUI without spawning llama-server; load on first inference-requiring interaction.
- GPU-lease awareness: before spawning the model server, check a lease surface (a running training process holding a launch receipt, or a simple lease file under scratch/ named by the live run) and boot model-less with a visible 'GPU leased to training: <run-id>' line in the status area instead. Observe mode (board pane, activity feed, receipts browsing) needs no resident model.
- The status line should always disclose whether a model is resident and how much VRAM it holds — the operator's audit channel should never hide a 10GB tenant.

## Coordination side (already mechanized, for the record)
Work-loop GPU-LEASE clause: no VRAM consumer launches while a training leg is live; training preflights assert no-inference-holder (no llama-server / :8082 listener) in the launch receipt.

title: W1 interpretation pre-registration: reading rules for the control-arm tokens_to_match receipt (filed before the confirmation receipt)
body:
# W1 interpretation pre-registration: reading rules for the control-arm tokens_to_match receipt

Filed against issue #121 (prereg governs). Reading RULES only — no verdicts about reality. All dispositions key on the CLEAN in-process receipt (L2); the attempt-2 crash trail (preserved at `B:/M/ember/scratch/w1-control/live/w1-live-20260707T091615Z/`) is a measurement trail, never a claim basis.

## §1 The measurement + provenance

Attempt-2 (receipt-less, crash-terminated) from-scratch control — rung-1 architecture, 1.22B params, bf16, batch 16 × seq 1024 — on the certified 16-window held-out batch: eval loss step0=10.5625 → step25 (409,600 tok)=10.0 → step50 (819,200 tok)=9.25 ≤ target 9.375; early-stop fired; terminal receipt crashed (path bug, fix in flight). Trajectory is steepening between intervals (−0.5625 then −0.75 per 409,600 tok), i.e. the control was nowhere near its own asymptote at stop. Grow-arm comparison bill: 12,550,144 tokens is the CUMULATIVE lineage bill (seed-pretrain 9,994,240 + pre-grow 983,040 + stabilize 1,572,864 = 96 steps × 16,384), NOT the grow step's marginal cost. Control ceiling 2.0× = 25,100,288 tok. Throughput 6665.66 tok/s.

Target provenance (runner lines 546–667): target_eval_loss computed once AT LAUNCH by evaluating the rung-1 grown checkpoint on the SAME 16-window batch, SAME eval_loss_fn, in bf16 — `loss.item()` quantized to 1 ULP = 0.0625 at magnitude ~10 (all four recorded values sit on that grid). The match margin 9.375−9.25 = 0.125 = exactly 2 bf16 ULPs on one 16-window batch against a single-evaluation target. Eval batch stratum: window indices 4,194,305–4,194,351 (~47 windows), decontam-certified (receipt 055843Z, 0 non-self matches / 6.98B windows). Training stream = corpus FRONT (windows 0..24527 at ceiling); that region's duplication saturation is UNMEASURED.

## §2 Outcome → claim ladder

| Clean-receipt outcome | Licensed claim | Rung |
|---|---|---|
| Match at ~same tokens (~819K, within one eval interval of step 50) | Replicated: from-scratch rung-1 control reaches the grown checkpoint's target (9.375, bf16, 16-window batch) in ~819,200 tok ≈ 6.5% of the 12.55M CUMULATIVE lineage bill. Caveats named in-claim: prices the whole lineage (seed-dominated), not the grow step; margin is 2 bf16 ULPs on 16 windows — equality is coarse until the §3 paired re-eval passes. Consistent with Ash & Adams warm-starting prior. | replicated-measurement |
| Match later (>2× tokens, ≤25.1M ceiling) | Measurement disagreement: crash trail and clean run bracket the crossing (0.8M–N). Only the clean run's N is claimable; seed/data-order variance becomes a named unknown; no "X% cheaper" number licensed. | interpretation-pending-checks (seed probe + discrepancy note required) |
| No match within 25,100,288 tok | Clean receipt contradicts the trail; only the clean run counts. From-scratch does NOT reach target within 2× the cumulative bill — evidence the rung-1 lineage carries value. Caveats: 16-window bf16 eval, training-front duplication unmeasured; attempt-2 becomes an anomaly requiring explanation before hardening. | measurement / interpretation-pending-checks |
| Match earlier (<409,600 tok) | Replicated in direction, stronger in magnitude (≤3.3% of bill); raises suspicion the TARGET is weak, not the control strong. Claim: rung-1 grow lineage's eval advantage is small-or-nil at THIS resolution; finer eval (fp32, larger batch) is the named next check before any "grow adds no value" promotion. | replicated (direction) / pending-checks (magnitude) |

## §3 Alternative explanations + discriminating checks (verifier-passed, rail-clean)

| Name | Check | Cost | Kills the collapse reading if |
|---|---|---|---|
| Eval noise + bf16 2-ULP margin (strongest attack; noise-floor figure "std≈0.7, cbase attempt-3" is UNSOURCED in this pack — trace to a receipt before it anchors anything) | Paired eval of step-50 control ckpt and grown ckpt on K fresh certified 16-window batches, fp32 loss accumulation; paired mean diff + bootstrap 95% CI. FEASIBILITY AMENDMENT (verifier): the certified stratum is ~47 windows ≈ 2–3 non-overlapping batches — a new decontam-certification pass over additional clean windows is REQUIRED to reach K≥10; budget that pass into the check | Minutes GPU forward-only + one certifier run (CPU); haiku-buildable off eval_loss_fn | Paired CI excludes zero in the grown checkpoint's favor. Conversely, collapse reading survives only if CI includes zero or favors control |
| Target self-comparison bias (single bf16 launch eval may be ULP-inflated) | Re-evaluate grown ckpt 10× on the same batch, fp32 accumulation, fixed seeds; diff launch-time vs in-loop eval code paths for mode/dtype asymmetry | Seconds GPU + code read (cheapest check) | fp32 re-eval lands materially below 9.375 — control never matched; early-stop fired on a quantization-inflated target |
| Trivial target (both arms in cheap early-descent regime; note: attempt-2 curve is STEEPENING, strengthening "pre-asymptotic") | Extend control (early-stop off, max_steps~200, existing runner/config) + continue grown ckpt; compare token-matched curves past the cheap region | ~10–30 min single-GPU, zero new code | From-scratch flattens sharply post-step-50 while grown arm sits on a better token-matched trajectory |
| Wrong comparison: cumulative bill vs grow-step marginal value | (a) eval PRE-grow ckpt on the certified batch (one forward pass); (b) continue-train pre-grow ckpt UNWIDENED for exactly 1,572,864 stabilize tokens, eval; marginal grow value = (b) − post-grow on paired batches | (a) seconds; (b) rung-0-width run, ~1.6M tok, minutes | Post-grow beats unwidened continuation at matched marginal tokens — the grow STEP added value; the match indicts seed/lineage economics, not the growth mechanism |
| Training-front duplication triviality | Run the existing decontam/duplication scanner (055843Z tooling) over windows 0..24527; report dup/near-dup fraction vs clean-stratum rate | CPU-only, tooling exists, <1h, haiku lane | Front region is duplication-saturated — control's descent partially memorization; collapse claim needs a rerun on certified-clean training data |
| Generalization vs single-stratum fit (Ash & Adams inversion) | Eval both ckpts on 3 out-of-region strata (different depth bands, 16–64 windows each, newly certified); per-stratum paired deltas | Forward-only minutes GPU + certifier runs (CPU) | Grown ckpt wins consistently out-of-region — single-stratum tie masked a generalization advantage |

All GPU checks run under the resource governor: VRAM-fraction cap + headroom assert on every launch. Agent routing: haiku default, budget caps apply.

## §4 P2 rung-1 lever decision rules (L7-shaped: park with a path, never kill)

1. **Match at ≤~1.6M tok (≤2× attempt-2) AND the §3 paired fresh-batch fp32 re-eval confirms** (CI includes zero or favors control) → PARK the rung-1 grow lever. Park-exit paths, filed on #121's successor: (a) a rung where from-scratch control cost exceeds the cumulative grow bill; (b) a specced shrink-perturb variant (Ash & Adams remedy). AMENDMENT (verifier finding 6): a bare token-match without the statistical confirmation licenses NO park — the paired re-eval is a mandatory gate, not an optional check.
2. **Match but >2× attempt-2 tokens** → HOLD: one more seed; disposition follows the 2-of-3 majority bracket; hold receipt names seed variance as the blocking unknown.
3. **No match within 25,100,288 tok** → HOLD the lever as provisionally-valuable. Required before promotion to "earns its bill": explain the attempt-2 discrepancy + measure training-front duplication (§3 rows 3, 5).
4. **Match <409,600 tok** → PARK with escalated path: before park-exit, re-measure the TARGET at finer resolution (fp32 accumulation, ≥128-window certified batch — requires the new certification pass from §3 row 1). A 2-ULP margin on 16 bf16 windows is too coarse to price a pillar.
5. **Always:** no disposition executes off the crash trail alone; every disposition files against #121's prereg and is disclosed in the window ledger same turn. Only the operator kills the lever (L7).

## §5 W2 G-arm inheritance (#113)

Unconditional: (1) from-scratch control as a co-launched leg BY CONSTRUCTION, never a follow-up; (2) target provenance fixed — computed at launch on the destination checkpoint, same eval_fn, upgraded to fp32 loss accumulation on a ≥128-window certified batch (bf16 2-ULP margin was W1's weakest joint; certifying that batch is a named pre-launch task, per the ~47-window stratum limit); (3) receipt schema splits grow-STEP marginal tokens from lineage cumulative — W1's billing caveat cannot recur; (4) training-region duplication measured for the G-arm's stream region before launch. Outcome-conditional: if W1 replicates the cheap-match (post-§3-confirmation), the G-arm carries a shrink-perturb third leg (test the field's remedy, not re-measure the pathology); if W1 fails-to-match, two-leg shape stands, control ceiling stays 2.0× cumulative.

## §6 What this prereg does NOT cover

- Any claim about growth at rungs >1, other architectures, or other data mixtures — this prices ONE lever at ONE rung on ONE stream.
- Generalization/downstream quality beyond the eval strata named in §3 (the 16-window batch measures next-token fit on a narrow slice).
- The grow STEP's marginal value unless §3 row 4 executes — absent it, all readings price the lineage, seed-dominated (9.99M of 12.55M).
- The noise-floor magnitude: the ~0.7 batch-std figure has no receipt in this pack; §3 row 1's paired design is chosen precisely so no reading depends on it.
- Net2Net's limitations section (abstract-only fetch — unverified) and L3 compliance (rail text absent from the grounding pack; flagged as a pack gap, not resolved here).
- Whether the training-front region is clean — unmeasured until §3 row 5 runs; every §2 claim inherits that caveat.

---
## Addendum (filed with the prereg, closing the verifier's headline gap)
The ~0.7 eval-noise figure the panel flagged as unsourced HAS a receipt: receipts/cbase-verify-attempt3-20260707T073843.json, field loss_std = 0.7059 (per-batch std across 10 seq-512 batches of the C-BASE checkpoint on real shards). Cross-checkpoint transferability to the W1 pair remains the named caveat (panel finding b3) - the sec.3 row-1 paired design is chosen so no reading depends on it.

Panel provenance: RESEARCH-LOOP-FABLE-PANEL workflow (2 fable seats blind-parallel + sonnet arithmetic verify + fable synthesis), run wf_043dbb9c-c88, 2026-07-07. Filed BEFORE the confirmation re-run receipt was read (the fix PR was not yet merged at filing time) - this issue IS the pre-registration.

title: Tighten classify_contamination_self_matches: interval-overlap should be strict containment (boundary-straddling foreign match could classify as self)
body: Follow-up from PR #330's gate (non-blocking finding). Current: is_self = any(gstart < c_end and gend > c_start ...) — interval OVERLAP. A foreign 13-token exact match partially straddling a candidate range boundary (shifted alignment, requires periodic/repeated content) would be excluded as self, theoretically masking a genuine boundary-adjacent duplicate. Fix: strict containment (gstart >= c_start and gend <= c_end); matches that overlap-but-exceed a candidate range must count as NON-SELF and refuse. Add a regression test for the straddling case (the PR's foreign-duplicate test only covers far-away, no-overlap). Does not affect the 2026-07-07 refusal forensics (all 16,208 matches were exact full self-matches).

title: MP contamination scanner: round-robin shard distribution skips 7 of 25 true shard boundaries (boundary-window coverage gap)
body:
Found during the 2026-07-07 W1 refusal forensics (launch lane's window-count reconciliation; the 84-window delta between the runner's recheck and the decontam receipt decoded exactly as 12*(n_groups-1) with n_groups=8).

DEFECT: contamination_recheck_mp (and the same pattern wherever build_decontam_batch_mp.py distributes shards) assigns shards to workers ROUND-ROBIN (group_idx = shard_idx % n_groups), so no worker ever holds two corpus-consecutive shards; each worker's boundary-join logic therefore joins round-robin-adjacent shards, scanning 26-n_groups FAKE boundaries while missing 7 of the 25 TRUE physical shard boundaries entirely. A 13-token window straddling one of those 7 boundaries is never hashed by the MP path.

IMPACT: narrow — only windows physically straddling the missed boundaries escape scanning (dozens of windows per boundary). Tonight's held-out receipt is UNAFFECTED (all 16 selected windows sit deep in shard-16's interior, receipts unchanged). But the gap is systematic: every MP scan to date shares it, and any future held-out window near a missed boundary would get a false CLEAN.

CURE (builder-dispatchable): distribute shards to workers as CONTIGUOUS ranges (worker k gets shards [k*g, (k+1)*g)) so intra-worker joins are true boundaries, and pass each worker its successor's first window-length tokens for the seam; OR keep round-robin and add a dedicated boundary pass that hashes the 25 true seams explicitly. Either way: a regression test that plants a duplicate straddling a true shard boundary and asserts the scanner finds it (fails at current head, passes at fix); and the window-count convention (boundary windows included) stated in the receipt so count deltas stop being forensic surprises.

title: Unlanded-lineage audit: third recurrence of the goalforge orphan class (capacity.py, manifest_sha.py/joules.py) — sweep + standing inventory
body:
Class, third receipted recurrence: work authored on a side lineage never lands on master, and the gap is discovered only when a launch or gate CRASHES over the missing file. Instances: capacity.py (flagged by PR #209), manifest_sha.py + joules.py + energy-law-theory-v1.md + pricing/rung receipts (the #322 W1 launch stop, 2026-07-07). Each discovery cost a blocked launch.

CURE (one-time sweep + standing mechanism):
1. Sweep: enumerate every local branch and worktree whose tip is NOT an ancestor of public/master (git branch -a --no-merged + git worktree list). For each: list files unique to it vs master (git diff --name-only master...tip), classify each file LAND (open a provenance-quoted PR) / RETIRE (superseded, say by what) / PARK (record why + revisit condition). The classification table IS the deliverable — exhaustive, including empty branches.
2. Standing mechanism: a branch-inventory row in CONTINUITY.md (branch -> tip -> unlanded-file count -> disposition), refreshed whenever CONTINUITY refreshes — staleness of that row then falls under the existing CONTINUITY staleness rule, so the inventory cannot rot silently.
3. Rails: read-only sweep; landings go through normal PR gates; nothing force-pushed; gitignored runtime artifacts (scratch receipts) recorded by path+sha in the table, never committed.

Known start set: goalforge/definitive-goal-20260701 (tip 067ac17 local-only; B:/M/ember-goalforge worktree detached at 60970d4 AHEAD of it — its delta unmapped), plus whatever the sweep finds.

title: W1 launch-blocked: #121's live path references an unlanded lineage + two spec-vs-code defects in w1_collapse_control_run.py
body:
Found by the W1 launch attempt 2026-07-07 (launch lane, honest stop — no GPU touched, no refs moved). The #121 refusal-proof half PASSED: three interlocks refuse correctly with named classes (W1_CONTROL_LAUNCH_INTERLOCK_REFUSED, W1_CONTROL_LIVE_NO_SHARDS, W1_CONTROL_LIVE_SECOND_INTERLOCK_REFUSED — verbatim quotes in the launch lane's log). At full authorization the live path CRASHES on missing artifacts instead of launching.

## Missing from master HEAD (verified via git cat-file + history search, not assumed)
1. `scratch/w1-control/w1-pricing-20260704T063236Z.json` (DEFAULT_PRICING_RECEIPT) — nowhere in tree.
2. `receipts/cbase-grow-rung/cbase-grow-rung1-live-20260703T155711Z.json` (DEFAULT_RUNG_RECEIPT) — nowhere; directory absent.
3. `scripts/manifest_sha.py` — imported unconditionally inside main_live's verify_shard_corpus(); exists only in unmerged commits a29ab4d/c63d31b (not ancestors of HEAD).
4. `scripts/joules.py` — the measured-watts sampler #121 requires; exists only in unmerged commits 8971127/067ac17 (same lineage, "goalforge" prefix — the class PR #209 already flagged for capacity.py).
5. `docs/energy-law-theory-v1.md` — the §6b instrumentation source; absent from tree AND full history; only a checker-run receipt survives.

## Spec-vs-code defects (independent of the missing files)
A. **Contamination verdict never gates.** contamination_recheck() computes CLEAN/CONTAMINATED but no code path refuses launch on CONTAMINATED — disclosed-only in the receipt. w2-scale-preregistration-v1.md §4 requires the launch gate to REFUSE (filter, not post-check). Cure: wire `scripts/w2_heldout/launch_gate.py` (refuse_or_pass/assert_launch_allowed — exists, well-built, and by its own docstring wired into nothing) into the live path.
B. **Curated held-out batch not consumable.** held_out_window_start() always recomputes "last N windows of the packed corpus"; there is no CLI to consume an external decontam receipt's verified window selection. The live decontam receipt (w2-heldout-decontam-20260707T055843Z.json) certifies windows starting at 4,194,304 with 32 replacement swaps — a different location entirely. Running --live as-coded would eval on an UNVERIFIED batch while citing the certified receipt in metadata: a receipt-integrity hazard, worse than a crash.

## Cure path (in order; builder-dispatchable after the lineage map lands)
1. Locate the goalforge lineage (map in flight: which refs carry the four commits; whether the two receipts exist on disk outside git).
2. Land manifest_sha.py + joules.py (+ the theory doc, or re-derive its §6b block from the checker script's expectations) via a reviewed PR — provenance quoted per file.
3. Same PR or follow-up: wire launch_gate.py into w1_collapse_control_run.py's live path (defect A) + add `--decontam-receipt <path>` consumption that rebuilds the batch from the receipt's selected_window_indices and asserts its batch_sha256 (defect B). Both changes are spec-COMPLIANCE fixes against the frozen prereg, with regression tests: launch attempt with CONTAMINATED verdict → refuses; batch sha mismatch → refuses; certified receipt → windows match the receipt's indices exactly.
4. Pricing/rung receipts: never fabricated — land from disk if found, else re-run their generation path.
5. Then #121 fires as specced.

title: T1 pilot pre-registration v1.1-PROPOSED: ember-lineage OCR bootstrap (M0-M3, panel-hardened)
body:
Research-loop tick 9 artifact. STATUS: PROPOSED — fires only after (a) L3 boundary ruling v2 ratification (#315), (b) the obtainability receipts below, (c) the one governance pick flagged in M1. Full derivation chain + panel adjudication: research-loop lab notebook (leo state, tick 9). Even a full kill is a D4 contribution: no published work reports a synthetic-only OCR seed evaluated on real historical scans (closest prior AT-ST, arXiv 2104.13037, never ran it — its authors document confirmation bias in second self-training rounds).

GOAL: decide with receipts whether ember-lineage OCR (synthetic-rendered training, L3-clean by construction) can convert scanned-PD books into training tokens — the gate on the 100B+ scanned-PD text universe (current clean ceiling: 10-30B human-keyed).

## Measurements (in order; each receipted; kill criteria BEFORE any run)

M0 — EDITION INTEGRITY (new, panel FATAL-1 cure): pilot books = PG texts WITH edition evidence only; per book: title-page match receipt; where multiple PD printings exist, scan-vs-scan diff on the M1 line sample — inter-edition disagreement >= the registered M3 delta drops the book. Track-kill if no 3 edition-pinned dual-observation books can be receipted.

M1 — CALIBRATION NOISE FLOOR F (PG-vs-scan CER on ~100 hand-transcribed lines; 9-strata sampling: book x page-third, RNG seed frozen in this issue before any scan is inspected; segmentation failures are the only permitted exclusions, logged; >10% segmentation failure = W3 blocks the pilot). Bootstrap CI on F mandatory; any downstream delta inside F's CI = INCONCLUSIVE by rule. Dual scoring under a PRE-REGISTERED normalization map (long-s->s, ligature expansion, u/v) — raw AND normalized (FATAL-2 cure). Bands: F<=0.5% usable; 0.5-2.0% expand to 300 lines + ground truth switches to hand-corrected subset; F>=2.0% with fallback failing = track-kill.
GOVERNANCE PICK (operator, at ratification): the transcription actor. An agent-lane transcriber places an external model in the calibration chain that sets the admission threshold tau — selection-adjacent under a strict L3 reading. Options: (A) operator hand-transcribes ~100 lines (~2-4h), or (B) ratify measurement-only calibration as outside L3's token-selection chain. Spec ships with both; neither is enacted here.

M2 — SYNTHETIC-SEED CER on the calibration set, TWO ARMS differing ONLY in font inventory (A modern-only / B +period-face revivals) to decompose degradation-shift (W1) vs typeface-gap (W2). Decision bands (disclosed as anchored to AT-ST's DIFFERENT regime — real-data seed at 1.03% — so these are decision rules, not truth claims; arithmetic per verify leg: kill bound = 19.42x that anchor): arm-B <=3% proceed; 3-20% proceed flagged; >=20% track-kill.

M2.5 — DIRECT S1 TEST (new, panel MAJOR-4 cure; pure inference, minutes): per-line confidence vs correctness on the calibration set -> ranking AUC + precision-at-tau curve. AUC <= 0.5+eps kills M3 UNRUN (confidence-filtered self-training cannot work if confidence does not rank correctness).

M3 — ONE self-training round (AT-ST recipe: transcription-posterior ranking, masking augmentation), REPEATED 3x with different pseudo-label subsamples; spread >= registered delta = INCONCLUSIVE by rule (FATAL-3 cure). Regime bands conditional on M2 seed CER: <5% AT-ST-comparable; 5-15% novel-regime (exploratory, own bands); >15% M3 void. Promote decisions from n=3 books are BANNED — the only promote is promote-to-larger-pilot (10-20 books). Kill: CER increases on majority of repeats, or top-confidence-decile CER >= overall seed CER. Per-book reporting mandatory; pooling banned.

## L3 toolchain law (hard, receipted BEFORE M1 fires)
- Segmenter NAMED + deterministic: projection-profile + Otsu + connected components; probe-gated (<10% line-failure on a real pilot scan, 20 spot crops receipted).
- IA/LoC bundled OCR text layers, confidence scores, and boxes: BANNED from every selection, cropping, edition-matching, and verification role.
- Font receipts per period face: license + fontTools glyph-coverage dump (U+017F, ct/st ligatures) + digitization-method disclosure.
- Degradation family: enumerated deterministic ops only (mirrored-page alpha bleed-through, morphological ink spread/erosion, threshold jitter, geometric warp, blur, JP2 recompression); implementation audited against the enumeration (no learned/GAN degraders).
- Toolchain audit receipt EXECUTED (every stage enumerated with provenance), not promised.
- Renderer determinism contract: (font, text, degradation-seed) provenance per line; identical seed -> identical pixels, hash-checked.

## Resource bill (designer estimate, verify-corrected; unverified engineering numbers flagged)
3 books, ~4.5K real lines, 2x100K synthetic lines, ~10 GPU-h (budget 15; wall-clock estimates unverified against any grounded 4090 timing), disk 10-14GB (well under the 100GB escalation), 3-5 days.

## Obtainability prerequisites (receipts before anything fires)
1. >=3 edition-pinned dual-observation books (IA/LoC scan id + PG id + title-page evidence).
2. Period-face revival fonts: free-license artifacts with verified long-s/ligature coverage.
3. Renderer determinism probe; segmentation probe on one real scan.
4. Downloads under the 2026-07-07 public-source standing authorization; sizes logged.

## Corpus-stage honesty clauses (bind any later build, not the pilot)
- L4 verifier field for confidence-admitted tokens: 'ember-ocr-confidence>=tau, calibration-CER=X at tau' — never 'verified'.
- Distribution audit: selected-vs-rejected line composition (typography density, page position) reported — ember-confidence selection biasing the realized corpus toward easy lines is the named science risk.

title: gate gap: C-BASE degeneracy hardening checks loss VARIANCE but not loss LEVEL — a random-logits receipt passes
body:
Found live 2026-07-07: a verification receipt (cbase-gpu-verify-hardened-20260707T053613Z.json, now VOIDED by VOID2) satisfied the #311 anti-degeneracy bar — its 10 losses varied across batches — while verifying nothing: every loss hugged ln(32000)=10.373 within ±0.009, the exact signature of a uniform random predictor (weights never loaded). Variance-hardening without level-hardening admits fabricated verifications.

Hardening spec for test_c_base.py (forward-only, probe-side, no receipt edits):
1. LEVEL check: reject any 'verification' loss trace whose mean sits within a band around ln(vocab_size) (e.g. |mean - ln(V)| < 0.05 with V from the receipt's own model block) — that level is only producible by uniform logits, which no trained-checkpoint verification can emit. If the eval data is random tokens, a real trained model produces CE ABOVE ln(V) (non-uniform q against uniform labels), never pinned AT it.
2. RESOURCE consistency: a receipt claiming device=GPU must carry vram_peak >= a floor derivable from its own model block (params x bytes/param x activation slack); 33MB peak for a 718M model is self-refuting and should auto-reject.
3. TEXT audit: reject verification.loss_function strings containing 'random logits' (a receipt describing its own loss as computed on random logits is not a verification of anything).
4. Regression fixtures: the VOIDED receipt itself becomes the negative test case; the honest-failure shape (a receipt reporting load-failure with no verdict claim) must still be accepted as a non-verdict artifact.

Class note: this is the second C-BASE receipt generation to fail in a NEW way after the previous hardening (bit-identical -> variance bar -> random-level). Each hardening must add its predecessor as a fixture, or the gate only ever blocks last night's fraud.

title: repo hygiene: tracked receipts/manifests carry machine-local absolute paths
body:
Found during the #309 independent gate: tracked JSON receipts and manifests on master carry machine-local absolute path strings (drive-letter roots) — e.g. totality receipts' root fields and verification manifests. These are not name leaks (pseudonymity intact) but they are developer-machine-specific strings in a public workbench.

Scope for a cleanup lane:
1. Enumerate: grep tracked files for drive-letter path patterns; classify receipt-internal fields (root, checkpoint_path, consulted) vs incidental strings.
2. Receipts are IMMUTABLE — never edit existing receipt files. The cure is forward-only: emitters switch to repo-relative paths (or a neutral placeholder root) so future receipts are clean; existing receipts stay as-is with this issue as the recorded disposition.
3. Emitters to touch: the totality runner's root/path stamping, checkpoint-discovery consulted-lists, verification manifest writers.
4. Acceptance: a fresh board receipt + a fresh discovery receipt contain zero drive-letter absolute paths; existing receipts untouched; regression grep in the leak gate so new tracked files carrying drive-letter paths are blocked at commit time.

Class note: this is the forward-only hygiene shape — the same supersede-never-edit discipline as receipt VOIDs.

title: P4: clean-corpus map v1 + L3 boundary ruling v2 (PROPOSED) — ratification + obtainability probes
